groups.name: Accessible and concealed branch routing
groups.guardrail: Calibrate accessible and finished routes separately; framing drills, openings and restoration never disappear into a cable-foot factor.

groups.name: Recessed lighting and switch-leg endpoints
groups.guardrail: Fixture count and route geometry remain separate; one first-light answer cannot become every additional-light unit.

groups.name: Surface raceway installation
groups.guardrail: Keep the selected raceway family and each required physical fitting count visible; product-specific accessories such as internal wire clips enter only when the declared system requires them.

groups.name: New branch breakers and endpoints
groups.guardrail: Larger conductors, exterior work, EVSE termination and 240V endpoints are proposed relationships, never copies of a 120V receptacle answer.

groups.name: Straightforward device replacements
groups.guardrail: Use several contractor answers to propose related device units; never apply one speed factor outside this physical family or auto-approve a proposal.

groups.name: High-amperage receptacle replacement
groups.guardrail: Confirm the existing receptacle configuration and mounting; a new circuit or conversion is a different recipe.

groups.name: Hardwired detector replacement
groups.guardrail: Existing compatible hardwired replacement only; do not transfer to new interconnect wiring.

groups.name: Connected and programmable controls
groups.guardrail: Hardware and commissioning are separate. Timer type and supported app/network responsibility must be bounded before proposing labor.

groups.name: Smart thermostat work
groups.guardrail: C-wire/power remediation and app commissioning are explicit adders; HVAC diagnosis is outside this recipe.

groups.name: Electrical-only appliance disconnect/reconnect
groups.guardrail: Do not transfer whole-appliance installation labor into the electrical-only scope.

groups.name: Overhead microwave and hood work
groups.guardrail: Only compare compatible under-cabinet/same-location scopes. Cabinet, duct, backsplash and new-circuit work remain separate or review-led.

groups.name: TV and soundbar mounting
groups.guardrail: Mounting labor cannot silently include power, concealment, backing, wall repair or connected-device setup.

groups.name: Data and coax cable points
groups.guardrail: UTP and coax retain separate published cable units; equality of one jack subcomponent does not merge whole-service labor.

groups.name: Doorbell and camera work
groups.guardrail: Physical installation, new wiring, transformer work and app/network commissioning stay independently visible.

groups.name: Bounded panel-device work
groups.guardrail: Repeated trips, unsuitable panels and capacity changes route away from replacement labor rather than becoming hidden adders.

groups.name: Panel replacement and service upgrade
groups.guardrail: Circuit counts, service-conductor footage and electrode count are measured inputs. Utility/permit coordination is not silently treated as field labor.

groups.name: Outdoor equipment and backup power
groups.guardrail: Never price the broad inactive services from an anchor alone. Equipment count, route, conductor count, bonding scope and selected system remain explicit facts.

groups.name: Lighting and fan installation
groups.guardrail: Replacement anchors never absorb new routing, fan support, high access, bathroom duct/housing changes or under-cabinet run geometry.
